1.title: 概覽
content: 身為垃圾鎮的領袖，![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王總是身先士卒帶領隊伍衝鋒陷陣。她的![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)指揮怒吼（Commanding Shout）能透過提升速度與給予額外生命值，激勵隊友奮勇作戰。

無論是在哪張地圖，或是雙方隊伍陣容為何，![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王總是尋求機會衝向敵陣。她會把握任何機會繞過敵方前線，並以蠻力擊殺對方的![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)醫護兵。
在沒有任何屏障或傷害減免手段的情況下，自我治療與聰明的走位是她存活並持續戰鬥的關鍵。只要能讓隊友保持緊密並跟隨她的腳步，他們就能勢如破竹地突破最堅固的防線。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 只有在看到推進並積極進攻敵方隊伍的機會時才使用「吶喊（Shout）」。如果隊友距離太遠，請不要使用。

* 保持「傷口（Wound）」傷害。循環使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)「大屠殺（Carnage）」、![](/data/assets/guide/f053add36af24437.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-blade.png)「鋸齒利刃（Jagged Blade）」以及近戰攻擊，以確保隨時對敵人造成「傷口（Wound）」效果。

* 等待敵方的大絕招反制手段交出。![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)「橫衝直撞（Rampage）」很容易被反制；如果敵人擁有像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子的「鈴（Suzu）」這類資源，請不要輕易使用。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 對她施加控場效果（CC）。![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王沒有任何應對控場的手段。利用暈眩和擊退效果將她控制在遠處。
* 保持距離。持續移動，盡量不要讓她進入斧頭的攻擊範圍。

* 攻擊她的隊友。垃圾鎮女王擁有大量的自我治療能力，因此很難擊殺。但作為一名![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克，她的體型較小，無法保護隊友免受你的傷害。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 速度加成
* 強勢的近戰纏鬥者
* 具備自我維持能力
* 沒有屏障
* 能力可被淨化
* 短程攻擊距離

3.1.1.title: 隊伍額外生命值與速度加成
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)戰鬥怒吼（Commanding Shout）是![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王能為隊伍帶來的最佳功能性技能。其廣大的範圍效果能立即為她與隊友提供額外生命值與速度加成。正因如此，她能促成一種圍繞著戰鬥怒吼冷卻時間進行的極度侵略性打法。

3.1.2.title: 致命鬥士
content: 一旦 ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王拉近與你的距離，她便能展現頂尖的近戰能力。![](/data/assets/guide/21f45973280e0d8a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fscattergun.png)散彈槍（Scattergun）能在近距離造成高額傷害，而她還擁有 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)大屠殺（Carnage）來穿透屏障，並繞過許多 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克唯一的防禦手段。

3.1.3.title: 自給自足
content: 透過傷口（Wounds）帶來的治療、戰吼（Shout）提供的超量生命值，以及野蠻滿足（Savage Satiation）特殊能力（Perk）賦予的吸血效果，![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王甚至不需要![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援來為她進行治療。這種自給自足的能力使她能夠深入敵陣、擊殺對手，並全身而退。

3.2.1.title: 沒有屏障或免疫能力
content: 垃圾鎮女王留給隊伍最大的弱點 ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png) 在於她缺乏保護自己或隊友的能力。她主要依靠自我治療來存活，但無法阻止敵人對她或她的盟友造成傷害。當面對擁有大量控場技能的隊伍時，她會特別感受到缺乏保護的劣勢，因為敵人可以將控場技能接連施放，而她卻無力阻止。

3.2.2.title: 傷口與禁止治療效果可以被淨化
content: 在《鬥陣特攻 2》中有許多技能可以淨化 ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王造成的傷口以及禁止治療效果。擁有消散（Fade）技能的英雄，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)莫伊拉和 ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神，可以淨化自身狀態；而擁有隊友淨化技能的英雄，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子和 ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)織命，則可以淨化他們的隊友。

3.2.3.title: 僅在近距離有效
content: 如果 ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王無法靠近敵人，她就無法發揮作用，也無法為隊伍提供任何價值。此外，如果她想要從 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)大屠殺（Carnage）中獲得最大效益，她必須同時接觸到多名敵人。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：散彈槍（Scattergun）
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/21f45973280e0d8a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fscattergun.png)散彈槍（Scattergun）的提示
* 射速緩慢

* 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/21f45973280e0d8a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fscattergun.png)散彈槍（Scattergun）的射速僅略高於每秒一發，射擊頻率非常緩慢。因此，採取單獨點擊並逐發射擊的方式，有助於提升你的準確度。
* 瞄準上胸部

* ![](/data/assets/guide/21f45973280e0d8a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fscattergun.png)散彈槍（Scattergun）的彈道擴散在瞄準上胸部時傷害效果最佳。這能最大化擊中目標的子彈數，並確保部分彈丸能造成暴擊。
* 在近距離交戰時，請直接瞄準頭部或下巴。
* 在交戰前重新裝填
* 如果你在進入近距離範圍前進行騷擾，這沒問題，因為這能累積少許絕招能量，但請務必在進入近距離戰鬥前確保彈匣是滿的。近距離才是你的主戰場，你需要在那裡輸出高額傷害，而不是停下來重新裝填。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：鋸齒利刃
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/f053add36af24437.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-blade.png)鋸齒利刃的使用技巧**
* 冷卻時間會在投擲後立即開始計算。
* 你可以將利刃留在被命中的敵人身上，直到你想將他們拉回來為止。這不會減少利刃的持續時間。
* 傷口
* 利刃在回程時會對路徑上的所有敵人造成傷口。
* 當利刃命中並留在敵人身上時，會直接觸發傷口。若裝備了次要特殊能力（Minor Perk），則僅在召回時觸發。
* 近戰傷口
* 只要垃圾鎮女王手持利刃（不在空中或未插在敵人身上時），她的近戰攻擊就會造成傷口。請務必在每幾次射擊之間穿插近戰攻擊，以利用額外的傷害與治療效果。
* 拉回控場（CC）
* 對抗任何打算跳躍或衝刺逃跑的英雄時，先用利刃命中他們，並等到他們啟動位移技能後再進行召回。

* 範例：命中 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓，接著等待他使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍，然後在他起跳的瞬間啟動召回，即可將他攔截在半空中。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：指揮怒吼
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)指揮怒吼的技巧**
* 用於發起進攻
* 當你準備好進場時，發動怒吼來提供額外生命值與移動速度，這將強化你的攻勢。
* 利用速度優勢衝過敵方前線，並鎖定他們較脆弱的後排。
* 用於反應

* 當敵人發動高價值攻擊（例如絕招）時，使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)指揮怒吼來幫助你與隊友存活。利用速度逃離，並利用生命值來承受傷害。
* 大範圍效果
* 與隊友溝通，或確保範圍內有盟友，以提升每次使用怒吼的效果。

4.4.title: [E]：屠戮（Carnage）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)屠戮（Carnage）的使用技巧**
* 旋轉視角以進行橫掃

* * 水平快速旋轉你的視角可以擴大 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)屠戮（Carnage）的命中判定範圍，有助於擊中額外的目標。
* 注意你的冷卻時間
* * 每擊中一名敵人可減少 2 秒冷卻時間。如果你擊中了多個目標，請調整位置，以便比平常更快地再次揮舞。
* 試著等待或誘騙出擊退技能
* * 面對擁有擊退技能的敵人時，試著觀察並追蹤他們的技能是否可用。被擊退可能會讓你原本威力巨大的揮斧變成一次巨大的失誤！

* 盡量將 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)屠戮（Carnage）留到對方使用過擊退技能後再施放。

* 戰吼（Shout）與 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)屠戮（Carnage）

* * 在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)屠戮（Carnage）前先使用戰吼（Shout），可以獲得額外的速度加成，幫助你順利命中揮斧。

* 戰吼（Shout）也可以在 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)屠戮（Carnage）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/f053add36af24437.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-blade.png)鋸齒利刃投擲（Jagged Blade Throw）施放期間同時使用。

4.5.title: 絕招：狂暴（Rampage）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)狂暴（Rampage）的使用技巧**
* 追蹤敵方的絕招反制手段

* * 像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)保護鈴（Protection Suzu）這類技能可以輕易地淨化「禁止治療」效果並阻止傷口癒合。像是 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎（Orisa）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍（Energy Javelin）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜（Ana）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）等暈眩與擊退技能，都可以在看到 ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)狂暴（Rampage）的啟動動畫時做出反應並進行反制。
* 小心不要在近期看過敵方使用這些技能後，還貿然使用你的絕招。
* 排列敵人位置

* * 站在一名敵人面前，並瞄準後方的敵人。你不需要為了等待五人命中的絕招而一直扣著 ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)狂暴（Rampage）不放，但請務必嘗試命中多個目標。

4.6.title: （被動技能）：腎上腺素激發
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/97e645527d54a63e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fadrenaline-rush.png)腎上腺素激發的技巧
* 隨時留意你的生命值

* 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王擁有大量的自我治療能力，因此隨時注意自己的生命值非常重要。這樣一來，你就能清楚知道何時該繼續進攻，以及何時該撤退至安全位置，並接受 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援角色的治療。

* 嘗試透過交替使用近戰攻擊、![](/data/assets/guide/f053add36af24437.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-blade.png)鋸齒利刃以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)大屠殺，來確保隨時對敵人造成流血傷害。

5.1.1.title: 橫衝直撞（Rampant Charge）
5.1.1.description: 使用「狂暴（Rampage）」時獲得「無法阻擋（Unstoppable）」狀態，並使所有冷卻時間縮短 6 秒。
content: * 與「戰鬥吶喊（Battle Shout）」帶來的較低但更頻繁的價值相比，這是一種將所有賭注押在絕招上的打法。

* 確保在啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)「狂暴（Rampage）」之前，先使用完所有的技能冷卻。
* 當你擁有絕招時，可以採取極度激進的打法，因為你將能夠連續施展兩輪技能循環。

5.1.2.title: 戰鬥吶喊
5.1.2.description: 指揮吶喊會完全填裝散彈槍，並提升盟友 50% 的裝填速度。
content: 「指揮吶喊會完全填裝散彈槍，並提升盟友 50% 的裝填速度。」
* 額外的侵略性
* 戰鬥吶喊透過減少裝填時間，使垃圾鎮女王與所有在吶喊範圍內的盟友能夠展現更強的侵略性。
* 裝填速度增益
* 在射擊 5 發後進行裝填，能確保你在吶喊結束前就開始裝填，並讓你受惠於 50% 的裝填速度提升。

5.2.1.title: 威利威利（Willy-Willy）
5.2.1.description: 當召回鋸齒利刃（Jagged Blade）時，其半徑增加 100%，並造成額外 30 點衝擊傷害。
content: * 更容易直接命中利刃，並獲得一點額外的爆發傷害來幫助確保擊殺。

* 還不錯，但只有在你每次嘗試使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)大屠殺（Carnage）時都被強硬控場（hard CC'd），且需要更多遠程輸出能力時才選擇它。

5.2.2.title: 野蠻飽足
5.2.2.description: 屠戮（Carnage）的衝擊傷害獲得 100% 普攻吸血。
content: 「屠戮（Carnage）的衝擊傷害獲得 100% 普攻吸血。」
* 推薦主要特殊能力
* 額外治療
* 每擊中一名敵人，她的斧頭會提供 105 點生命值治療。將此數值乘以擊中的敵人數量，並考慮到每擊中一名敵人也會使 8 秒的冷卻時間縮短 2 秒。
* 當裝備野蠻飽足時，垃圾鎮女王的坦克能力會大幅提升。

* 如果你用一次斧頭揮擊擊中兩名敵人，垃圾鎮女王總共可獲得 390 點治療量（衝擊吸血加上傷口效果），並且能在 4 秒後再次使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)屠戮（Carnage）。

6.title: 地圖
content: 在目標點周圍地形較為平坦的地圖，最適合 ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王發揮。她雖然能透過「戰吼（Shout）」獲得不錯的地面機動性，但缺乏垂直移動能力，也無法在遠距離與佔據高處的敵人交戰。若地圖擁有過多高台，她將難以穩定發揮價值。此外，過於空曠或視線範圍過長的地圖對垃圾鎮女王來說相當不利，因為她沒有直接應對遠程消耗傷害的手段。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王在鬥毆與衝鋒陣容中表現出色，她的續戰力與 ![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)命令怒吼（Commanding Shout）的範圍增益效果能讓會戰迅速滾起雪球。她與那些需要在她有效射程內戰鬥的輸出型英雄搭配極佳，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神、![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美、![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)卡西迪與 ![](/data/assets/guide/90fbc15b3208bec3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmizuki.png)瑞稀，這些英雄能從速度與護甲加成中獲得極大優勢。全員隨著怒吼一同向前推進，能促成侵略性的開戰並讓隊伍佔據空間。

擁有爆發傷害的英雄，如 ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)禪亞塔或 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西，能有效將 ![](/data/assets/guide/f053add36af24437.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-blade.png)鋸齒利刃（Jagged Blade）拉回的目標轉化為擊殺。

在輔助方面，垃圾鎮女王擁有充足的自我治療能力，因此她主要需要能協助她進行侵略性打法的輔助技能。![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)路西歐能透過「加速增益（Speed Boost）」發起進攻，這讓女王能保留「命令怒吼」來應對敵方的反擊嘗試。面對任何機動性較差的陣容，這將創造出壓倒性的會戰優勢，直接輾壓對手。

霧子也是極佳的搭配人選，因為 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)保護鈴（Protection Suzu）可以抵銷那些在會戰中足以讓女王陷入困境的禁療或控場效果，而 ![](/data/assets/guide/d4bee70da37be094.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fkitsune-rush.png)狐狸湧現（Kitsune Rush）對女王而言幾乎等同於第二次絕招。
在競技對戰中，由於團隊協調性不一，女王在隊伍能果斷投入會戰時表現最為突出；半吊子的進攻正是她最容易受到懲罰的情況。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/452c9a51fb58d39d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjunker-queen.png)垃圾鎮女王最可靠的方法，就是拒絕讓她進入 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)大屠殺（Carnage）的攻擊範圍，並限制她造成「傷口」的持續時間。當你看到她準備施展 ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)大屠殺（Carnage）時，應立即使用位移技能，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/76027704b29fb3cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fenergy-javelin.png)能量標槍（Energy Javelin）、![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）、![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)教練槍（Coach Gun）以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)鞭擊（Whip Shot）。

她難以應對消耗型與高地控制型陣容，這類陣容會強迫她在進入最佳攻擊範圍前先承受消耗傷害。像 ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬、![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西、![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)索潔恩或 ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)伊拉里這類英雄，可以從遠距離對她施加壓力，迫使她為了縮短距離而被迫交出「戰吼」來防禦。一旦「戰吼」被使用，她將失去機動性與額外生命值，變得容易受到爆發性集火攻擊。

反治療與脫戰工具也至關重要。![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜的 ![](/data/assets/guide/5845366bf977ed06.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbiotic-grenade.png)生化手榴彈（Biotic Grenade）能抵銷她的生命竊取，這會大幅降低她的生存能力。![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)保護鈴（Protection Suzu）則能透過治療並淨化所有隊友，直接讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)暴衝（Rampage）的效果完全失效。

總體而言，不要在她的主場進行持久戰。採取風箏戰術後撤並等待 ![](/data/assets/guide/6015e8c1fd972a00.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcommanding-shout.png)戰吼（Commanding Shout）效果結束，隨後再發動攻勢。只要可能，請保持在她的攻擊範圍之外，她的價值就會大幅下降。

8.2.title: 特定英雄剋制名單
content: * 席格馬
* 艾西
* 索潔恩
* 伊拉里
* 安娜
